scope: A symbol-specific classification for the analytic fractional-cusp composition operator on complex coefficient-weighted Hardy Hilbert spaces with geometrically lacunary power-logarithmic exceptional weights.
title: A four-regime cusp-composition transition for lacunary weighted Hardy spaces
